criteria.notes: The app proves the requested vertical slice: nested app-owned scenes are edited in a dedicated settings surface, saved as one structured value, and passively rotated without a datasource.
This is a creative-led example with no supplied visual reference; the rendered result matches the frozen editorial direction and all declared signature choices.
Publication typography, asymmetric sequence fields, restrained index lines, and layout-specific statement, quote, and schedule scenes create a distinctive exhibition identity without dashboard cards.
Titles, labels, details, and collection identity remain room-readable across Full HD, wide-low, portrait, square, and long-copy scenarios.
Dark and custom light palettes preserve clear foreground, metadata, rule, and accent-field contrast without relying on color alone for structure.
Auto-fit bounds, descender-safe padding, deliberate contextual ellipsis, and the dedicated long-copy scenario show no text ink clipping or overflow.
The composition deliberately changes for wide-low, portrait, and square surfaces while preserving collection identity, sequence, primary title, and operational detail.
The app-specific icon and placeholder derive from the approved visual system, all assets resolve, and coral, cobalt, sun, and mint tones remain coherent in both theme families.
The editorial sequence, monumental numbering, and nested custom editor are materially different from the maintained table, queue, dashboard, feed, media, and wayfinding examples.

screenshots.notes: Full HD statement scene inspected: hierarchy, index, body, detail, and accent field are balanced with no clipping or accidental empty bands.
Compact landscape inspected: essential title, index, detail, and accent geometry remain legible and inside the assigned surface.
Portrait inspected at full resolution: masthead, horizontal index, scene copy, and bottom color field form a deliberate vertical composition.
Custom light palette inspected: all foreground and muted text remains readable against the configured ground, stage, and accent colors.
Empty state inspected: no bundled scene leaks through and the editor recovery instruction is clear without creating a fake content layout.
Long-copy scene inspected: title and body fit their bounded regions at readable sizes with intact descenders and a fully visible detail line.
Named portrait scenario inspected and matches the approved portrait composition without overflow or overlap.
Quote scene inspected: serif quotation hierarchy, supporting copy, attribution, and cobalt sequence field read as a distinct authored composition.
Schedule scene inspected: time and location detail, concise activity copy, and sun accent remain clear without borrowing dashboard grammar.
Square scenario inspected: compact masthead, sequence index, story title, detail, and bottom accent field all remain inside the 600px surface.
Wide-low scenario inspected: supporting copy is intentionally removed before primary hierarchy, producing a clean signage band with no clipped text.
Required square preset inspected and preserves the same complete compact hierarchy as its named scenario.
Required wide-low preset inspected: the stage fills the band, the title remains dominant, and the accent field stays proportionate.
